tidbit: Did you know… a story marked Still open means nobody on the record has confirmed it yet.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
An ex-Anthropic researcher testified before the NYC Council about artificial intelligence risks that are poorly understood, Confirmed by Bloomberg Law News.
The Pentagon has officially ended its use of Anthropic's Claude after a six-month phase-out, shifting to OpenAI and Google tools, Still open per Android Headlines.
Lila Ibrahim, Google's first Chief Artificial Intelligence Readiness Officer, shared how she uses the technology in her daily life, Confirmed by CNBC.
Nvidia-backed Reflection has unveiled an open artificial intelligence model, Reported by Bloomberg.
Apple is warning that artificial intelligence agents with Full Disk Access on Mac could expose your data, Confirmed by Yahoo Tech.
Free every hour.
